about: Feature record filler mutants (wf10 TS1). Killed by TestVectorRecordsRegenerate (the vectors' records are what the parser makes) and TestRecordSurvivesWhitespace (a reformat that keeps the lines keeps the record).

mutants.name: ts1-depth-from-indentation
mutants.rule: Depth is the syntactic nesting of the line's first byte, not its indentation.

mutants.name: ts1-comment-text-untrimmed
mutants.rule: A comment's text has no trailing spaces or tabs, so trailing whitespace leaves the record.

mutants.name: ts1-doc-from-attachment
mutants.rule: A comment the tree attaches to a declaration or a member (an operation, a law) is a doc comment.

mutants.name: ts1-literal-words
mutants.rule: The words of a literal are not code words.

mutants.name: ts1-arm-rethrows
mutants.rule: An arm whose value is the failure it bound rethrows.
